answer: Sequential dependency chains make puppets wait. Rewards require an identity to be born from an existing account through an atlas entry: a signed sponsor certificate that also inherits the sponsor own backlog, so a new key cannot claim until its sponsor claims and passes review. A thousand fakes from one root form a cipher chain a thousand deep, the last clone waiting a thousand cycles. Spreading across shallow roots needs a thousand verified sponsors, each signing an onyx certificate with its own reputation at stake; honest newcomers inherit one short chain.
